goal: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE. Step 1: in the Branch dropdown, explicitly use the select tool to select the option 'MAIN-001 - Main Office', even if it already appears selected by default -- this step is required, do not skip it. Step 2: type operator ID 'teller1' into the Operator ID field. Step 3: type password 'password' into the Password field. Step 4: click the Sign On button. Step 5: after reaching the main menu, read the MAIN MENU heading text as an output named menu_heading. Then call done.
